title: Dashfy Project Configuration
description: The dashfy.json project configuration written by `dashfy init` and read by add, remove, and doctor.

registries.description: Custom registry endpoints, merged over the built-in @getdashfy namespace.

params.description: Query parameters sent with each request. Values may reference ${ENV_VAR}.

headers.description: Headers sent with each request. Values may reference ${ENV_VAR}.

paths.description: Where the CLI applies changes. Takes precedence over its file discovery.

app.description: File that registers widgets via WidgetRegistry.addExtension (e.g. src/App.tsx).

server.description: Dashfy server entry that registers data sources (e.g. dashfy.server.ts).

env.description: Environment file seeded with an extension's envVars (e.g. .env).
